newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-IRISH APPOINT ENGLISHMAN ASHTON AS NEW COACH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-IRISH APPOINT ENGLISHMAN ASHTON AS NEW COACH.

text.p: Ireland appointed Englishman Brian Ashton as their new coach on Thursday following the resignation of New Zealander Murray Kidd.
"This is a great honour for me and I look forward to working with the team during the Five Nations championship," he said.
Ashton, who played once at scrum-half for England, quit as coach of English club champions Bath on Monday.
His first match in charge will be the Five Nations clash against France in Dublin on January 18 when Ireland seek to make amends for their surprise 37-29 home defeat by Italy last weekend.
His appointment is a blow to England coach Jack Rowell who had wanted to give Ashton, his coaching colleague at Bath from 1989-94, a role in the English set-up.
"I have it in mind to involve Brian," Rowell had said on Wednesday. "I have spoken to him unofficially."
